valid:
run NegativeScenario1 {
    some disj p1, p2 : Person |
    some disj c1 : Course |
    some disj pr1 : Project |
    some disj g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2
        Course = c1
        Project = pr1
        Grade = g1

        Person <: teaches = p1->c1
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1
        Person <: projects = p2->pr1

        Course <: projects = c1->pr1
        Course <: grades = none->none->none

        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj p1, p2, s1 : Person |
    some disj c1, c2 : Course |
    some disj pr1, pr2 : Project |
    some disj g1 : Grade {
        Person = p1 + p2 + s1
        Professor = p1 + p2
        Student = p2 + s1
        Course = c1 + c2
        Project = pr1 + pr2
        Grade = g1

        Person <: teaches = p1->c1 + p2->c2
        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + s1->c2
        Person <: projects = p2->pr1 + s1->pr2

        Course <: projects = c1->pr1 + c2->pr2
        Course <: grades = none->none->none

        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 3 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 2 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

        Person <: enrolled = p2->c1 + p1->c2
        Person <: projects = p2->pr1 + p1->pr2

        Course <: projects = c1->pr1 + c2->pr2
        Course <: grades = none->none->none

        Grade <: next = none->none
    }
} for exactly 2 Person, exactly 2 Course, exactly 2 Project, exactly 1 Grade expect 0

parse:
run NegativeScenario2 {
    some disj prof, s1, s2 : Person |
    some disj c : Course |
    some disj pr : Project |
    some disj g1, g2 : Grade {
        Person = prof + s1 + s2
        Professor = prof
        Student = s1 + s2
        Course = c
        Project = pr
        Grade = g1 + g2
        Person <: teaches = prof->c
        Person <: enrolled = s1->c + s2->c
        Person <: projects = s2->pr
        Course <: projects = c->pr
        Course <: grades = c->s1->g2 + c->s2->g1
        Grade <: next = g1->g2
    }
} for mouse: exactly 3 Person, exactly 1 Course, exactly 1 Project, exactly 2 Grade expect 0
